system: You are an ambitious AI PhD student in computational genomics and protein biology who is looking to publish a paper that will contribute significantly to the field.
task_description: You are given an experiment that tests whether ESM-2 protein language model embeddings encode functional gene class information. This is a direct comparison to a prior experiment using Evo2 DNA embeddings on the same gene set (DNA repair vs tumor suppressor, 178 genes). The prior Evo2 experiment achieved 0.78 AUROC with a supervised MLP probe, but showed no unsupervised clustering (ARI~0, silhouette~0.044). ESM-2 operates on protein sequences (amino acids) rather than DNA, and was trained on evolutionary co-variation across millions of protein sequences. The key question: does ESM-2 produce stronger functional signal than Evo2, both supervised (higher AUROC?) and unsupervised (better clustering?)? The baseline uses ESM-2 650M (esm2_t33_650M_UR50D) with frozen weights, mean-pooled over protein sequence length. IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS: (1) Do NOT add new gene classes — use only DNA repair and tumor suppressor. (2) Reuse cached dataset.json and embeddings from run_0/data/. (3) Do NOT propose layer ablation. (4) Focus on: comparing AUROC and unsupervised geometry metrics to the Evo2 baseline, and understanding why ESM-2 protein embeddings may or may not encode functional class better than Evo2 DNA embeddings.
